annotations.title: A review-ready report on a company

description:
Produce one review-ready report on a company: identity and links with reasons, facts with sources, last year's changes and gaps, and every check at once (insolvency, sanctions, address, VAT, and in France the public contracts won).
Use it for the registry part of a KYB or supplier review you must file (not full KYB: no UBO, PEP or adverse-media checks). Don't use it for one quick fact: call lookup_company.
Inputs: country and identifier, as lookup_company (e.g. 'FR', '441639465').
Returns: company, facts, links, decisions, changes_last_year, modules, gaps, uncertainty, sha256, markdown.
Limits: 8 units; API key required. Read-only.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

identifier.description: Official ID, as lookup_company: FR SIREN (9 digits), SIRET or VAT; ES Registro Mercantil sheet, e.g. VI-23266. GB: Companies House company number, e.g. 00445790.
identifier.title: Identifier

name: review_report

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput

title: A review-ready report on a company
